notes: v031 is selected to the base; φησιν is translated at t009.
τά takes thy under rule 76's availability test: σε is already spent on thee as the verb's object, so it is not available to take the possessive — the same shape as rule 76's laid his hand on him.
The ASV's gloss note (Greek turneth thee to madness) confirms that mad at t024 renders εἰς μανίαν, one aligned unit on the noun under rules 39, 93 and 94.
